note: vespera_macro: a mixed externally tagged enum (unit and data variants) gets a {Name}Input request view, so request bodies accept a unit variant's {"Name": null} map form. A tuple struct / tuple variant with a skip_serializing_if position gets an Input view (serde still reads every position). rust_decimal Decimal accepts a JSON number as well as a decimal string in the request view. Path<TupleStruct> with one read position next to skipped ones documents that position, and a non-string Path field reached through serde(flatten) is documented as a string (axum hands buffered values over as strings). error_status entries that cannot carry content (1xx, 204, 205, 304) are documented without the error body. A return alias resolves in the top-level handler's module before a same-named helper fn in an inline module, test-only modules are skipped, and use crate::X / use super::X of a struct stops the crate-wide alias search.
